import core::option;

fn before() -> i32 { return 1; }

pub gen fn grid_cells(rows: i32, cols: i32) -> i32 {
    let r: i32 = 0;
    while (r < rows) {
        let c: i32 = 0;
        if (r == 3) { return; } else { yield 0 - 1; }
        while (c < cols) {
            yield r * 10 + c;
            c += 1;
        }
        r += 1;
    }
    yield 999;
}

fn between() -> i32 { return 2; }

gen fn once() -> bool {
    yield true;
}

fn after() -> i32 { return 3; }
